newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary could sell extra HUF 80bln of assets - APV.
newsitem.headline: Hungary could sell extra HUF 80bln of assets - APV.

text.p: Hungary's state privatisation agency APV said it could sell some 80 billion forint worth of its assets currently designated for permanent state ownership if parliamentary amended the privatisation law.
"We see a real chance for the sale of assets of 80 billion forints " APV Deputy General Director Miklos Kamaras told a news conference.
Hungary's privatisation law specifies what assets the state plans to keep in its permanent ownership.
APV said it could find buyers for up to 80 billion forint worth of these assets if it cannot meet its sales target and the state budget needs revenues.
APV did not disclose what companies the 80 billion forints included.
It said it planned to generate revenues of up to 180 billion forints this year.
